message: Add a model source registry so clients can register bring-your-own-key model sources with the host, and use their models in any session or automation.
details: // A client asks the host to register a source in a format the agent reads.
// The host publishes it with root/modelSourceSet. While its state is authRequired,
// the client delivers the key with an authenticate target of kind 'modelSource'.

Agents advertise the formats they read in `AgentCapabilities.modelSourceRegistration`. Requests and turns that need an unavailable source fail with `AhpErrorCodes.ModelSourceUnavailable` (`-32013`), which a turn's error part carries in the new optional `ErrorInfo.errorCode`.
